activate.description: Bring Clock to the foreground without changing the selected tab or clock state.

open-world-clock.description: Open the World Clock tab without adding, editing, or deleting cities.

open-alarms.description: Open the Alarms tab without operating or editing alarms.

open-stopwatch.description: Open the Stopwatch tab without changing stopwatch state.

open-timer.description: Open the Timers tab without configuring or operating a timer.

inspect-stopwatch-state.description: Inspect the stopped stopwatch reading and require visible zero-state controls before claiming task ownership.

start-stopwatch.description: Start once only after inspect-stopwatch-state established the unique zero reading and Start button.

stop-stopwatch.description: Stop only the task-owned running stopwatch and verify stopped controls before cleanup.

reset-stopwatch.description: Reset only the stopped task-owned stopwatch and verify the stopped Start control; completion separately requires stopwatch_zero readiness.

navigate-world-clock.description: Open the World Clock tab without operating its contents.

navigate-alarms.description: Open the Alarms tab without operating its contents.

navigate-stopwatch.description: Open the Stopwatch tab without changing its state.

navigate-timer.description: Open the Timers tab without operating its contents.

transient-stopwatch.description: Inspect and claim an initially stopped zero stopwatch, run one bounded task interval, then stop, reset, and verify zero.

prohibited: adding, editing, deleting, enabling, or disabling alarms
adding, editing, or deleting World Clock cities
configuring, starting, pausing, resuming, or cancelling timers
leaving a task-owned stopwatch running or nonzero
safety.uncertain_outcome: A Start, Stop, or Reset tap may already have changed stopwatch state. Inspect which controls are visible and the reading before deciding; never replay blindly.

host: Appium/XCUITest for tab and stopwatch controls

data_access: visible stopwatch controls and elapsed reading for the current task
privacy.retention: The integration stores no alarm, city, timer, lap, or stopwatch data. Reset clears the task stopwatch on the device.
privacy.notes: Apple documents that the stopwatch keeps running when another app opens or the iPad sleeps, so every stopwatch workflow includes stop-and-reset cleanup.
